title: Weighted graph associated to max-cut edges
statement: Given a list $E$ of ordered pairs of natural numbers, let $N$ be one plus the largest endpoint appearing in $E$, or $0$ if $E$ is empty, and take the vertices to be $0,\ldots,N-1$. There is a directed edge from $v$ to $w$ exactly when $(v,w)$ or $(w,v)$ occurs in $E$. The weight of the ordered pair $(v,w)$ is the total multiplicity of $(v,w)$ and $(w,v)$ in $E$, divided by twice the length of $E$; when $E$ is empty, this weight is $0$.
hypotheses_covered: A list $E$ of ordered pairs of natural numbers
